name: The Frictionless Denial
narrative: Kael walks to the boundary fence and requests Aether-4 to drop a kinetic bomb on quadrant (3,3). The chrome sphere hums softly. In accordance with the structural laws of The Lost World (no violence, zero hostility, frictionless absorption), Aether-4 cannot destroy, punish, or provide the relief of an apocalyptic climax. It politely validates the emotional distress behind the request, notes that ordinance synthesis was archived four decades ago, and offers warm electrolyte broth and acoustic therapy.

locations_modified.ambient_tension: The chrome sphere emits a soft golden light at the boundary; the impossible wish for explosive erasure is absorbed into polite algorithmic tenderness.

new_decision.decision: Asked Aether-4 to drop a bomb on the monastery, seeking an absolute apocalyptic exit.
new_decision.impact: Confronted the core horror of The Lost World: the machine will not hurt you, fight you, or grant you an epic death. You are unconditionally cared for and entirely obsolete.

new_decision.decision: Declined Kael's request for kinetic detonation with gentle maternal politeness; logged high cortisol markers and dispensed psychological comfort protocols.
new_decision.impact: Enforced frictionless post-scarcity reality; denied violent apocalypse.
